extraction.Name: Margaret White Deer
extraction.Recorded patent: I did not record the parent, but delivered the patent when I sold the land, and probably the purchaser had the patent recorded.
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: I, the patentee, sold the land, all of it, never mortgaged it.
extraction.Buyer: Sold to Mr. Snodgrass, a banker at that time in Interior, S.D. for $1,000.00 cash
extraction.Occupation/Income: A monthly allowance from her Individual Indian Money
extraction.NOTES: Mentally sound, physically poor and feeble; has about $500.00 individual money at the present time, from which she is drawing a monthly allowance for her support. No dependents excepting herself. Sale was considered a fair price for the land at that time. Document notarized December 4, 1928, before Elmer B. Pomeroy, Notary Public, Washington County, State of South Dakota.
